entities.summary: Zoltán Gyimesi is a Hungarian chess grandmaster and national champion in 2005. He has participated in four Chess Olympiads with a record of +11=18-4. In 2002, at the 35th Chess Olympiad, the Hungarian team won the silver medal with Gyimesi on the fourth board.
